entries.zh: 亡魂显现；亡者显灵（鬼魂出现）
entries.en: to appear (of a dead person); the appearing of a ghost
entries.notes: H 首字存疑（玄/顯），L 末段「estalsa dotrina」疑为「esta es la dotrina」旁注，语义主要据 L 前半与 M/R 音读定。

entries.en: to appear miraculously; to manifest in incarnate form
banquet mat; to prepare and lay out a feast
entries.notes: M 栏五音节与单字 H「筵」、单音节 R 不合，L 末「vt messa la」疑残，义仅据 H/R 定。

entries.en: to fit out, to get (gear or implements) ready
entries.notes: L 末「para mechos」不成词，语义据 H「具」及 M/R 音读定。

entries.en: to get everything ready (for a banquet)
entries.notes: H 第二字存疑（備/倍），据 L「necesario para el convite」与 R gōy 取「備」。

entries.en: to arrange, to set in order
to prepare and lay out a banquet
to arrange them evenly, whether sparse or dense
entries.notes: H 第三字存疑（疏/踈），L「si este ygual」文意不全，义据「排平……密」组合定。

entries.en: to prepare, to get done
entries.notes: H 作「辨」而 R 兼注 pān，当为「辦」之借写；释义依赖此字通假推断。

entries.en: to prepare tea
to get what is needed ready
prepared but not yet complete or perfect
to set up, to arrange
to lay out the feast mats; to set a banquet
to set the table; to prepare a feast (also to invite guests)
to prepare; prepared
entries.notes: H 存疑（備/倍），M「Bāy」与 R「pȳ」不协，取「備」义。

entries.en: to get ready, to prepare (anything)
entries.notes: H 首字存疑（備/倍），第二字「辨」通「辦」，故释为备办。

entries.en: to make ready, to prepare

entries.zh: 便利有益；备妥而可供实用
entries.en: to be ready and serviceable; convenient and profitable
opportunely, as chance offers; ready without premeditation
to arrange the tables (for a feast)
to arrange the wine (for a wedding feast)
entries.notes: R 栏第三音节 T99 污损且重出「chiu」，按规程降为 low；H「安排酒」与 L「o boda」足以定语义。
